methodologyNotes: Specs sourced primarily from Newegg product listings (newegg.com search pages, June 2026) which aggregate manufacturer spec sheets. Supplementary sources: LG product page (lg.com/us) for LG 27GX790A-B connectivity; Apple macrumors.com roundup for Studio Display and Studio Display XDR launch prices and release dates; Apple specs page (apple.com/studio-display/specs) for Studio Display port details; ASUS ProArt product listing for PA279CRV; BenQ product page (benq.com/en-us) for PD2706UA HDR and USB-C PD details. The Gigabyte M27Q is noted as discontinued/unavailable at major US retailers as of June 2026 — it is included for its historical buyer-comparison relevance (2021 launch) with specs from archived Gigabyte product page data and community consensus; priceUsd is the historical US MSRP at launch. priceUsd is US launch MSRP for the base/reference config. Numbers are stored unit-free; units implied by key name (size_in = diagonal inches, refresh_hz = Hz, response_ms = milliseconds GTG). release is YYYY-MM or YYYY. ports is a concise string listing video inputs and key USB/power-delivery ports. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on every source. VERIFICATION PASS (2026-06-15): high-profile entries independently cross-checked against manufacturer/authoritative sources. Corrections applied: Dell U2725QE HDR 400->600, PD 96W->140W, HDMI 2.0->2.1, price $659.99->$699.99 (Dell MSRP vs Newegg sale); ASUS PG27AQDP price $799.99->$999.99 (ASUS MSRP vs Newegg discount) and release 2024-05->2024-09; Alienware AW2725DF price $649.99->$899.99 and ports corrected (2x DP 1.4 / 1x HDMI 2.1, was inverted); Alienware AW2725D panel OLED->QD-OLED; Samsung G8 panel OLED->QD-OLED and HDR->True Black 400; Apple Studio Display releaseDate 2022-03->2026-03 to match its Thunderbolt 5 specs (the TB5/A19 entry is the 2026 refresh, not the original TB3 2022 unit). OLED HDR labels normalized to 'True Black 400' where applicable.
